question: $9.$ 设 $z=f(x,y)$ 可微，且 $z$ 满足 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\cos x\cdot f'(x,y)+y$，$\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\cos y\cdot f'(x,y)+x$，则 $\frac{1}{\cos x}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+\frac{1}{\cos y}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\underline{\qquad\qquad}$
